alt: July 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of a misty rainforest of tall trees and broad leaves, its green paint dripping down like rain.
caption: A watercolor forest calendar for July 2025.
description: A watercolor illustration of a dense forest with tall trees and lush foliage dominates the top of a white calendar page. The artwork features drips and splatters of green paint flowing down from the bottom of the illustration. Below the art, the month of July for the year 2025 is written next to a grid of dates with the days of the week labeled.
